shows.title: Disaster Preparedness / Occult Practices
shows.first_half: First Half: Author William Forstchen will discuss what recent disasters can teach us about preparedness. He'll examine our vulnerabilities to major disruptions, including threats to electrical and communications systems, as well as the potential impact of EMPs and solar storms.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Sal Santoro practices a variety of occult philosophies, combining different traditions and systems into practical ritual magick. He'll delve into the hidden traditions of sorcery and planetary magick, the timing and mechanics of effective spellwork, and experiences drawn from more than three decades in the field.

shows.title: Pergamon Altar Mystery / Lunar Exploration
shows.first_half: First Half: Author Jonathan Cahn has spoken at the UN and to millions worldwide. His work focuses on biblical prophecy, connecting ancient Hebrew scriptures to modern global events, and the end times. He'll explore the stunning mystery of the ancient Pergamon Altar and its possible connection to the events shaping our world today.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Author Brooks Agnew will discuss NASA’s Artemis III program and the rapidly advancing science of fusion rocketry. He'll examine the issues behind the postponement of the program’s lunar landing and share his thoughts on China’s plans to build a base of operations near the Moon’s South Pole.

shows.title: Luck & Manifestation / Souls & Intuition
shows.first_half: First Half: Clinical psychologist and psychokinesis expert Dr. Joe Gallenberger will share new success stories from his Liquid Luck meditation, along with experiences from the first six Inner Vegas Virtual workshops. He'll also discuss his SyncCreation course on psychokinesis, healing, and manifestation, as well as the Monroe Institute's expanding offerings.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Carole Obley is a spiritual medium and author who explores the bridge between heaven and earth. She'll reveal how to align with your soul’s purpose by opening and trusting your inner senses and intuition, and conduct live readings during the last hour.

shows.title: Shadow People & Hat Man / Open Lines
shows.first_half: Heidi Hollis is an author and researcher credited with discovering, naming, and defining Shadow People and the Hat Man. Her research explores the striking connections between ufology, the paranormal, and the spiritual, revealing what she describes as a secret war spanning dimensions. Followed by Open Lines during the latter half. Give George a call to discuss whatever’s on your mind!
